acceptanceCriteria: A1: PhysicalExecution identity excludes Work Item identity and includes repository snapshot command environment runtime and toolchain bindings
A2: A shared physical execution result can bind to two Work Items while producing distinct Work Item Evidence Receipts
A3: No Work Item may reference another Work Item's Evidence Receipt as its own authorization evidence
A4: Cross repository snapshot runtime command or toolchain mismatch cannot coalesce and fails closed
A5: Physical execution reuse is an optimization only and does not weaken required verification or governance evidence
A6: Tri-language documentation explains PhysicalExecution ExecutionResult and per-Work-Item EvidenceReceipt boundaries
goal: Separate shared physical verification work from Work Item-specific authorization evidence so parallel Work Items can reuse execution cost without sharing governance receipts.
intent: Introduce an explicit PhysicalExecution and ExecutionResult identity that can be independently bound to per-Work-Item EvidenceReceipt records without cross-Work-Item authorization reuse.
outOfScope: Policy planner or affected dependency semantics
Performance targets or cross-process persistent cache
Runtime global project state or global Agent configuration

scenarioCoverage.scenario: shared physical execution binds distinct Work Item evidence receipts
scenarioCoverage.expected: Two Work Items may reuse one physical result but each receives an identity-bound receipt and cross-binding is rejected.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run physical execution coordinator and receipt binding tests for valid A/B bindings and a tampered cross-Work-Item receipt.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: repository snapshot runtime command or toolchain mismatch
scenarioCoverage.expected: Mismatched physical execution keys never coalesce and fail closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run key mismatch tests for repository snapshot runtime command and toolchain dimensions.
